items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Oh, well, the ones I know, Henry Zeno, Ernestopano, John Veen, Arnold Piers, Ray Happi.

ctx.x: What about drummers when you were young? Do they have any good drummers there?
Oh, well, the ones I know, Henry Zeno, Ernestopano, John Veen, Arnold Piers, Ray Happi. And, uh, what do you call this player there? Good drummers.
Who did these guys play with, the different ones you mentioned?
